messages:
Mira Chen: Hey folks — PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6234. It contains the KV-prefetch fallback plus a tiny auth header ordering fix. Need runtime + platform + infra + security eyes. Prefer to land in today's 16:00 merge window if possible. Can someone own canary and merge steward? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam Ortiz: I can take runtime review. Will skim in ~30m. Any staging diff or scripts I should run locally?
Mira Chen: Thanks Sam — no schema changes. Quick smoke: `./scripts/run-integration -t kv` and `make smoke-staging`. I added a short runbook in the PR description (under "Testing notes"). Also added a feature flag `kv.prefetch.fallback` (default:on).
Jordan Lee: Platform notes — we should do a 4h canary behind the flag and add a rollout policy to the service config (see `infra/services/runtime/configs/rollout.yaml`). Also please add a note for fallback routing so we can metric-snooze if latency spikes. I can own the canary if needed.
Ashley Gomez: Infra: I need the autoscaler annotation tweak (`autoscaler.alpha.redwood/evict-threshold: "0.75"`) included in the manifest before canary. Also send me exact staging pods to run the smoke so I can reproduce locally.
Harpreet Singh: Security quick check: the header-ordering change touches auth flow. Please add a short threat-model blurb in PR describing why ordering is safe (no new headers accepted from client), and paste any relevant logs. I can do a light review in ~1h.
Mira Chen: Added the autoscaler annotation and a threat-model subsection in the PR body (under "Security notes"). Pushed commit `c9f3a2b`. I also added commands to reproduce the smoke test.
Sam Ortiz: small nit in `kv_cache.go` (concurrency comment). I'll approve once that's clarified. Otherwise LGTM.
Mira Chen: Fixed the comment and force-pushed `c9f3a2b -> d1e7f9c`.
Jordan Lee: I can take the canary and monitor dashboards at 16:00 — tagging on-call logs and latency panels. Assigning myself as merge steward unless someone objects. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @Jordan Lee for 2024-08-12T16:00:00Z. Canary window: 4h.
Harpreet Singh: Thanks, Mira — looks good from my side now. Leaving a couple of tiny suggestions but no blockers.
Ashley Gomez: I'll run the infra smoke at 15:30 and post results here. If all green, Jordan can proceed with canary.
Mira Chen: Awesome, appreciate the quick turnaround everyone. I'll hold off merging until you confirm, Jordan/Ashley.
Jordan Lee: Will post a go/no-go at 15:45.
Mira Chen: Great — tagging this thread in the PR for traceability. :white_check_mark:
